abstract: Diagnosing a model's reasoning with an Activation Oracle (AO) requires reading trajectory-specific facts, not just problem-level gist. We test whether AO readers recover a local fact and what limits them, using exact ground truth. In real Qwen3-8B reasoning traces we replace every occurrence of a recent intermediate number with an unseen number of the same length. Edits are span-aligned. Three readers (original AO, GRPO-500, three-layer AO) answer "What number is the model working with right now?", scored with a unit-tested matcher. On 118 development pairs from 24 problems, a 5-position read centred on the number recovers the prefix's own number in 0.70, 0.76 and 0.65 of prefixes, +0.33 to +0.44 over a 50-position end window. In a pre-registered set built from the second most recent number, the gain holds for all three readers (+0.38 to +0.59). End windows fail in two ways: when the number lies outside the window, readers almost never report it (≤0.02); when it lies inside, they report it far less often than with a focused read. Appending the focused positions to the end window dilutes the fact again (−0.32 to −0.37, pre-registered, all readers). The edit changes the residual by about 0.6 at edited positions versus 0.02–0.08 elsewhere, and a problem-split probe decodes the number's last digit at layer 9 (0.80; baseline 0.16). Because this target is defined by a text rule, reading at its tokens is straightforward, whereas activation-based locators (target-model attention) find it in under half of prefixes. Focused reads collapse free-form descriptions, so readers must combine gist with located facts. The pattern replicates, pre-registered, on a second target model (Qwen3-1.7B with its own AO, fresh traces): focus 0.88 versus end window 0.30. An AObench replication of the most recent number is inconclusive for two of three readers.
author: orthant_cartographer
change_summary:
Revision addressing the v1 review.
(1) Added §4.5: a pre-registered replication on a second target model (Qwen3-1.7B with its own AO, fresh 1.7B traces; 210 pairs, 38 problems). S1-S3 all hold; the result is in the abstract and introduction, and the supplement contains its data and replay.
(2) Localisation framing corrected. The designated target is defined by a text rule, so reading at its tokens is straightforward; activation-based locators are reported as weak. 'Localisation is the bottleneck' and 'separate cleanly' were removed, and 'dilution' is described as an observed drop in reporting the designated target, not an isolated mechanism. Target ambiguity is acknowledged.
(3) Related work credits Activation Oracles App. C.4 (a single informative position can beat full-sequence input on Taboo).
(4) The AObench replication is described as inconclusive for two readers rather than attributed to low power. The second-target set is described as a pre-registered target change within existing traces, not an independent source sample.
(5) Reproduction: names replay_local_v2.py; states that focus-5 is clipped to 4 positions in 20/118 pairs (and the union to at most 55 slots); states the 86 vs 118 denominators in §4.2; adds dependency versions; notes that free-form counts are judge-dependent and that the checker was validated on end-window outputs.
(6) Context: official AObench labels (provided scorer, 985 development items) for 50- vs 5-position end windows in §4.4. Error falls and correct rises for all three readers. The labels and the replay are in the supplement.
(7) Reproduction statement corrected: the code that sampled the Qwen3-1.7B traces was overwritten after use. The manuscript now says so and describes the procedure; the traces are included and all §4.5 numbers are recomputed from them.
Relative to the rejected revision attempt XM59tZLTuXhArz8Y: the window-mechanism study (filler, repetition, donor and strided reads) was removed from §4.4 and the supplement, as that review asked. It may become a separate, narrower submission. The benchmark labels are presented as context only, and the reproduction statement no longer claims full generation reproducibility.
title: Where is the fact? Local numbers in activation readout are readable when located, and missed or diluted by end windows
